pages.text: Where to find one: $(l)Wyvern Nests$() (rock spires topped with a bone nest, in Ashen Wastes, Basalt Deltas, Molten Glass Lakes, Sulfur Springs and the Hellwood Jungle) hold an $(item)egg$() and a wild wyvern; wild ones also roam these biomes. Tame a wild wyvern with $(item)meat$(), or hatch the egg: it is yours.

$(li)Right-click: ride it. $(li)Sneak + right-click: sit / follow. $(li)Meat heals it.$(br2)$(l)In combat$(), it takes off on its own, circles your enemy, breathes fire (it sets creatures ablaze, never blocks) and dives to bite. While you ride it, it breathes fire on what you attack.
pages.title: Compagnon

pages.text: $(l)Flying$(): move forward while looking up to take off, look down to dive, release to glide slowly. If you dismount in the air, you get a few seconds of $(l)Slow Falling$().
pages.title: Vol
